title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
A major worker of Macrotermes michaelseni taking care of the fungal garden. Photo credit: Risto Vesala.

This month's cover image is provided by the authors of ‘Nutritional dynamics in fungus-growing termites: Integration of biological nitrogen fixation and microbial amino acids’ (https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2435.70108), which features in this issue. They investigated nutritional interactions between Kenyan Macrotermes michaelseni termites and their symbiotic fungi and bacteria and found that the termites rely heavily on their fungal partner, Termitomyces, for their essential amino acids, especially during early development. Together with demonstrated associations with fixation of atmospheric nitrogen, these findings underscore the intricate collaborative interactions among bacterial, fungal and insect metabolisms that support the protein supply within this symbiotic system.
